addendum_hash_recipe.note: Recompute from this committed file alone; depends on every field except addendum_hash.

amendment_rule: Sealed before the first XV-F1 freeze (16:00 UTC on the effective day). Any further change is another dated addendum.

challenger_xv_f1.abstains: XV-F1 writes no row for a pool (the champion row is kept) if the daily point for today or 30 days ago is missing, the pool has fewer than 60 own 14-day starts, or fewer than 50 daily returns in the last 60 days.
challenger_xv_f1.never_the_headline: XV-F1 never sets the tier or the headline number, and is not scored by family addendum 3 (that scores the headline forecast). It is not shown on the board; it is in the daily manifest, the outcome files and every verdict's promotion_tests.
challenger_xv_f1.storage_and_publication: Its own table and record_id, joined to the champion row by source_record_id; champion rows and their prediction_hash are unchanged. Published in the SAME pre-window daily manifest as the champion, under 'challengers', with its own batch_root and per-row prediction_hash. Graded on exactly the champion row's outcome (same pool, same window).
challenger_xv_f1.what: The champion's own payoff, (1 + fee14) x (1 + IL(r)) - 1, with two inputs changed. fee14 is the pool's fee return over the last 30 days (from the on-chain 00:00 UTC daily points), scaled to 14 days as (1 + fee30)^(14/30) - 1, instead of 2 x the last 7 days. The price moves r are the pool's own historical 14-day moves (the champion's trailing <= 730 starts), standardized by their own log standard deviation and rescaled to the last 60 days' daily log-return volatility x sqrt(14), instead of being used as they were. p_lose = share of outcomes below 0; p_lose1 = share below -1%.

promotion_rule.text: XV-F1 replaces XV-B1 as the headline only if, over >= min_days matured freeze days since effective_from_freeze_day, its paired Brier skill vs XV-B1 on 'lose' (1 - Brier(XV-F1) / Brier(XV-B1) over the same rows) is >= min_skill with the moving-block 95% CI (whole freeze days, the standard's block_days and resamples, seed = the standard's seed + seed_offset) entirely above 0, AND its Brier on 'lose1' is not worse (point estimate). This is the XV-H1 rule of the sealed standard, unchanged. If XV-H1 and XV-F1 both qualify at the same verdict, the one with the larger paired skill on 'lose' is promoted. A promotion is a new sealed model version, effective from a later freeze, never back-applied; every result of this test is published in each verdict, pass or not.

research_disclosure.caveats: Historical outcomes use 00:00 UTC daily points, not the 16:00 collector samples the live board grades on. The holdout's last week (anchors 2026-09-23..29) overlaps the first live XRPL v2 windows. A backtest is not a forecast record: XV-F1 counts only from its first pre-registered freeze, and on history it sits near, not clearly above, the 0.05 skill bar of family addendum 3.
research_disclosure.dev: 5,775 items. Skill vs climatology: champion -0.041, XV-H1 +0.062, 30-day fees +0.051, 60-day vol +0.019, both (picked, = XV-F1) +0.071, both with 30-day vol +0.031.
research_disclosure.holdout: 5,712 items, 272 days. Skill vs climatology: champion -0.049 (95% CI -0.118..+0.002), XV-H1 +0.008, XV-F1 +0.048 (95% CI +0.001..+0.086). Brier on 'lose': champion 0.2269, XV-F1 0.2032 (paired skill about +10%); on 'lose1': 0.0683 vs 0.0646.
research_disclosure.protocol: Walk-forward on the on-chain daily history (21 pools, 00:00 UTC points from the full-history ledger); inputs from days <= the anchor only; outcome = exact LP-vs-HOLD net over the next 14 days. Four variants of the champion (30-day fees; 60-day volatility rescaling; both; both with 30-day volatility) were compared on DEV anchors 2025-04-01..2025-12-31 only; the best by pooled Brier skill vs per-stratum climatology was picked; HOLDOUT anchors 2026-01-01..2026-09-29 were scored once, for the picked variant, the champion and XV-H1.
research_disclosure.why_now: On the first graded XRPL v2 rows the champion was right on average but no better than one number for every pool. Instead of loosening any test, this adds a better-founded challenger that must earn promotion under the rule already sealed for XV-H1.

title: XRPL v2 addendum 1: a second pre-registered challenger, XV-F1 (30-day fees, 60-day volatility)
what_does_not_change: The champion (XV-B1), its tiers, every published row, the standard's verdict rule, the XV-H1 challenger and its promotion rule, family addenda 1 to 3. Nothing frozen before effective_from_freeze_day is affected.
